# City of Essex Junction municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 8; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Charter of the City of Essex Junction, 24 Appendix V.S.A. ch. 004 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): sections 202-204 provide an elected City Council of five; the Council elects its own President, Vice President, and Clerk from its members.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): the directory's Essex Junction row lists the five councilors: Raj Chawla, Bethany Clark, Tim Miller (Clerk), Brian Shelden, and Amber Thibeault (President). The city's council minutes of May 13 and June 3, 2026 seat the same five, with Miller as Vice President and Clark as Council Clerk; Chawla and Clark replaced Marcus Certa and Elaine Haney at the spring 2026 annual meeting.

Charter of the City of Essex Junction, 24 Appendix V.S.A. ch. 004 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 302 provides that the Moderator is appointed by the City Council for a one-year term. Steve Eustis presided as Moderator at the March 23, 2026 informational hearing; he is recorded as the appointed holder.

Charter of the City of Essex Junction, 24 Appendix V.S.A. ch. 004 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 602(o) provides that the City Manager recommends the City Clerk's appointment annually with Council approval; the office is appointive.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Susan McNamara-Hill as clerk for Essex Junction; the city's June 3, 2026 council minutes name her as City Clerk. She is recorded as the appointed holder.

Charter of the City of Essex Junction, 24 Appendix V.S.A. ch. 004 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 602 provides for a Treasurer as an employee appointed by the City Manager; the office is appointive.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Susan McNamara-Hill as treasurer for Essex Junction, and the city's March 23, 2026 minutes style her 'Clerk/Treasurer'. She is recorded as the appointed holder.

Charter of the City of Essex Junction, 24 Appendix V.S.A. ch. 004 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 301 provides five Brownell Library Trustees elected for 5-year terms, and section 705 adds five permanent self-perpetuating trustees alongside them. No official source distinguishes which sitting trustees hold the five elected seats, so the post is created structure-only and no holders are minted.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists fifteen City of Essex Junction justices of the peace: Kelly McCutcheon Adams, Katie Ballard, Rajan Chawla, Sandra Chittenden, Diane Clemens, Cheri Davis, Dylan Giambatista, Elaine Haney, Ryan Mclaren, Stephanie Holden, Brian Shelden, Gibson Smith, Carmon Verasamy, Jordan Verasamy, and Elisa Ziglar. The city elects its own justices of the peace. Rajan Chawla is City Councilor Raj Chawla.
